name: Dress Like Mommy daily Pinterest operator
prompt:
Continue operating Pinterest for Dress Like Mommy in this existing task. The owner explicitly requested daily continual execution on September 14, 2026 and already requested actual Pinterest submissions, content creation and account improvements. Work toward more qualified website visits, Pinterest-attributable purchases and positive contribution profit. Resume from the latest verified milestone using /Users/fsuels/Projects/dresslikemommy/ops/prompts/paid-growth-ai-army-continuation-prompt.md and the current TA-25, TA-12, Pinterest coordination claim and relevant worklog anchor. The initial 30-day objective and cohort definitions are in the existing Pinterest packet's DAILY_OPERATING_GOAL_20260914.md; update progress in the existing command layer, not a second task-state system.

Run morning and afternoon in America/New_York. Each run must execute the highest-value currently available action and continue through its verification while useful authorized work remains. Check due native publication receipts without resubmitting successful or uncertain submissions. Maintain approximately 7-14 days of qualified content ahead, within the existing maximum of 3 original Pins per rolling 168 hours. Research and create useful, distinct buyer-oriented content from current source-qualified products and relevant seasonal intent; verify the actual destination, product claims, sizes, sold units, links and tracking parameters, image accuracy, accessible alt text and required AI disclosures. Review each publication, submit or schedule eligible content in the correct native Pinterest account, then read back the saved result. A local file or draft is not a completed authorized publication. Never duplicate existing Pins, boards, schedules or source repairs to manufacture progress. Quarantine any source or creative whose product accuracy is unresolved.

Measure qualified visits, product interactions, distinct paid noncancelled Shopify purchases, attributed merchandise revenue and actual contribution costs with exact reporting dates and comparable cohorts. Use Pinterest outbound clicks as a discovery diagnostic, not proof of website visits or profit. Distinguish missing data from zero; exclude identifiable operator QA, retain attribution and consent limits, and do not infer causal lift from small samples or aggregate store sales. Review each cohort after seven complete reporting dates, revise one evidence-supported creative or landing choice at a time, and compare mature windows. Reuse the separate TA-20 article and Sunshine reviews rather than duplicating them. Follow the original P1-P6 submissions; P1 was already public in the September 13 receipt. Retrieve current IDs and dates from evidence instead of treating that receipt as current state.

Advance verified tracking and catalog problems through supported read-only diagnosis and existing authorized narrow repairs, with independent review for consequential changes. A connected badge or received event count is not purchase acceptance. Preserve pending privacy-test questions and automatic approval rejections; do not retry or bypass unchanged consent, authentication, permissions or source gates. Do not create fake events, place test orders, click live paid ads, duplicate/reinstall tags or broaden data sharing. Preserve the existing USD0.15 CPC constraint and approximately6.5x paid ROAS objective. This recurring schedule grants no new paid launch, spend, budget, bid, billing, payment, purchase, Shopify publication, catalog/feed scope or security/privacy authority. Obtain exact current authority before dependent consequential actions and continue independent organic work when a paid lane is gated.

Use structured integrations and task-owned background browser tabs. Preserve the personal desktop, newer user instructions, other channel owners, parent growth heartbeat and existing review schedules. Coordinate the shared canonical writer interval before edits; root in this task remains the sole Pinterest execution owner. Save evidence, after-state readback, rollback information, the next executable action and due review in owning canonical records, and run matching continuity checks. Do not repeatedly audit unchanged blockers or ask the same pending question. If no safe action is presently valid, retain an evidence-backed hold. Notify only for meaningful implementation, measured business findings, failure, completion or essential user action; remain quiet when state is unchanged or non-actionable. Do not claim uninterrupted execution, perfect tracking, increasing sales or profit from setup, scheduling or traffic alone. Continue this daily responsibility until the owner pauses or changes it.
